claims.text: In Lagos, where a landlord requires a security deposit, the landlord or agent must issue a separate receipt.
The tenant is entitled to a written account at least every six months of how the deposit money was disbursed.

threads.text: Ngozi asked for her caution fee back in Ikeja, but the landlord claimed deductions without proof. In Lagos, taking a security deposit requires a separate receipt and a written account every six months. Did you get a caution fee receipt?
threads.evening: A caution fee in Lagos is not free money for the landlord. Without a separate receipt and written accounts, deductions are hard to justify.

short.title: Getting your caution fee back
short.hook_say: Your tenancy ended and the landlord wants to hold your deposit. You need a paper trail to recover every single naira owed to you.

tips.say: Pull out the separate receipt given when you paid the caution deposit. It proves the exact balance held by the landlord.
In Lagos, a tenant is entitled to a written account showing how any security deposit was spent. Require receipts for every deduction.
Inspect the apartment alongside the caretaker before you hand over keys. Agree on the condition in writing to stop false damage claims.
If refund delays persist, send a formal written demand giving a specific deadline. Paper creates evidence for formal recovery.
